XXIII."), an argument line, an italic salutation, and the opening paragraph of the letter. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: teris optime merito, me quoque illi una cum orbe universo plurimum debere, fac quæso certiorem; si apud me aliquid aliud reperiri compererit, quod ad publicam utilitatem desideret, paratus sum, omnibus quæ possideo, & ipsi, & literatorum reipublicæ inservire. Tu interim vale, amantissime Pater mihiqve semper & bonis omnibus merito apprimeqve Reverende, & mei memor vive tui observantissimi.

p.i: Romæ, Idibus Martii partæ salutis Anno MDCXXXI.

main_text.head: EPIST. XXIII.
P. à Valle Jo. Morino de suo exemplari Samaritano.

p.i: Admodum Reverendo Patri, atque eruditissimo Domino suo, Patri J. Morino Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero, Petrus à Valle Peregrinus S.P.D.

main_text.p: NUnquam molestè tuli, mirificè, cul-tè atque amantissime mi Pater,
Jo. Morino's name and the Latin salutation are printed in italic; the dateline is set in italic roman.

page.notes: The superscript letter "a" after "una" at the end of the first line is printed raised; it is not expanded and may be a printer's reference mark, so it is left out of the text. The dark vertical band at the right edge is a scanner shadow and is not transcribed. The printed "u" is written as "v" in the original, normalised here to u/v per the rules (e.g. "qvoqve" to "quoque", "qvæso" to "quæso"). The year "clɔ Ɔcxxxı" is read as MDCXXXI. The initial "N" is a drop cap and is joined to "Unquam" as "NUnquam".
